plain_english_definition: A point spread or total we calculate ourselves from official results, instead of copying a sportsbook's number.
how_it_is_computed_here: Ridge regression of home margin on team indicators, fitted only on weeks before the game being predicted.

plain_english_definition: A way of fitting a model that stops extreme team ratings running away when a club has played only a few games.
how_it_is_computed_here: Solved in closed form with a penalty of 5.0 on the size of every team rating.

plain_english_definition: Home team's points minus the away team's points. Positive means the home team won.
how_it_is_computed_here: Straight from the official final scores.

plain_english_definition: Predicting each week using only the weeks before it, so the test can never see the future.
how_it_is_computed_here: Week N is predicted from weeks 1 to N-1 only.

plain_english_definition: A prediction made on data the model never saw while it was being fitted.
how_it_is_computed_here: Every row of backtest_walkforward.csv.

plain_english_definition: A game played abroad, where neither club has a home crowd.
how_it_is_computed_here: Marked from the official nfl.com weekly schedule pages; home-field advantage is set to zero for these games.

plain_english_definition: How many points the home team is worth before you even look at who is playing.
how_it_is_computed_here: Mean home margin across non-neutral games, reported with a 95 per cent confidence interval.

plain_english_definition: Mean absolute error: on average, how many points a prediction missed by.
how_it_is_computed_here: Average of the absolute margin errors, compared against the naive alternative of predicting a zero margin every game.

plain_english_definition: Whether the misses lean one way. Positive means the model under-rated the home team on average.
how_it_is_computed_here: Simple mean of the margin errors.

plain_english_definition: The share of bets you must win just to cover the book's commission.
how_it_is_computed_here: At -110 you risk 1.00 to win 0.909, so break-even is 1.10 / 2.10 = 52.38 per cent.

plain_english_definition: A range for a hit rate that behaves properly on small samples.
how_it_is_computed_here: Wilson score interval at 95 per cent.

plain_english_definition: A correction applied when several signals are tested at once, because testing many signals manufactures winners.
how_it_is_computed_here: Step-down adjustment across the skill signals only; the bias probe is excluded.

plain_english_definition: A Sharpe ratio adjusted for how many strategies were tried and for lopsided returns. It asks: would this still look good if I had only ever tried one thing?
how_it_is_computed_here: Bailey and Lopez de Prado (2014), using the measured skew and excess kurtosis and a trials count equal to the number of signals tested.

plain_english_definition: How lopsided and how fat-tailed the per-bet returns are. Both make a good-looking record less trustworthy.
how_it_is_computed_here: Computed directly on the per-bet return series: +0.909 for a win, -1.000 for a loss.

plain_english_definition: How far down a club's published depth chart a position has to reach. Zero means the first string starts; two means the third string starts.
how_it_is_computed_here: Walk the club's published depth order and skip any player the official injury report lists as Out.

plain_english_definition: Which line of the depth chart is expected to start: 1 means first string, 2 means second string and so on.
how_it_is_computed_here: Position of the expected starter in the club's published order.

plain_english_definition: How much better the price you took was than the price available when the game started.
how_it_is_computed_here: NOT COMPUTED. It needs a market price and no official source publishes one (flag F-01).

plain_english_definition: Bet size expressed as multiples of your standard stake.
how_it_is_computed_here: One unit risked: a win at -110 returns +0.909 units, a loss returns -1.000.

plain_english_definition: How much two numbers move together, from -1 to +1.
how_it_is_computed_here: Standard Pearson correlation with a Fisher z confidence interval.

plain_english_definition: Several bets on one game combined into a single ticket. The legs are not independent.
how_it_is_computed_here: Not priced here; the inputs you would need are the correlations in correlations.csv plus real parlay prices from a book.

plain_english_definition: Whether a number was read off an official source or not.
how_it_is_computed_here: Every row carries its source URL. Anything without an official source is left blank and given a flag.
